name: Dororo ~Jigoku Emaki no Shou~
source: Hyakkimaru is a young man who lacks 48 body parts because they were taken from him by demons before birth, as payment by his father, Kagemitsu Daigo, to obtain his wish to take over the country. When the baby boy was born he was missing 48 parts of his body, and thus was abandoned—thrown into a river. Hyakkimaru has grown up and now has obtained fake body parts so he can eliminate the 48 demons that were made from his body, and to retrieve his missing parts. Along for the adventure is the boy thief, Dororo, with whom he becomes friends.
translation: 百鬼丸尚未出生，父亲醍醐景光便以他身上的48个部位为代价与群魔交易，换取自己夺取天下的愿望。因此，他降生时全身缺少48处，随即遭到遗弃，被扔进河中。如今百鬼丸已经长大，还装上了义肢。他踏上旅程，准备消灭当年的48只妖魔，夺回失去的身体。与他同行的是少年小偷多罗罗，两人也在旅途中结为好友。
